findings.message:
[P2] Bound the terminal retirement retry

When KV remains unavailable or `kv.delete` continues to reject, this loop never resolves. The sideband bridge waits on this promise before calling `closeDownstream`, so an already-upgraded client remains open indefinitely and the retry timer continues running instead of receiving the 1011 failure close. Use a bounded or abortable retry, or decouple the retry from socket closure behind a durable retirement marker.

src/live/upstream.ts:176-181

summary: The retry closes the transient deletion gap but can leave terminal sideband connections open indefinitely when KV does not recover.

evidence: src/live/upstream.ts adds a pending-retirement guard and retries `getKv()` and `kv.delete()` until the mapping is removed.
tests/live-sideband-http.test.ts exercises an unavailable KV opener and a delete rejection, then verifies the mapping is removed and a reconnect receives 404 without dialing upstream.
